violated_contract: Every image accepted by a Cloudflare route's declared byte and pixel limits must be processed within the hosted runtime envelope while preserving orientation, metadata removal, and exact persisted/provider bytes. Passing CPython or local workerd tests does not establish hosted memory or temporary-file behavior.
canonical_prevention: Keep bounded multipart parsing in memory, delegate full-resolution decoding to Cloudflare Images, and enforce container orientation/metadata rules without allocating source-sized pixel canvases. Exercise the actual hosted code at supported byte/pixel boundaries and test privacy, orientation, provider failure, and no-temporary-file behavior in the existing route lane.
